findings: obligation_coverage: Reconstructed the operations demanded by the seven canonical targets and the smooth-manifold baseline, then challenged them against S01 O01–O28. The current route contains all decisive constructions: metric/curvature entrance, radial differential and Taylor term, current-vector Hessian, Riccati/trace, singular scalar boundary, Gram density, uncut substitution, angular limit, absolutely continuous weighted average, Myers endpoint, index trial fields, complete exponential covering and triangle globalization. The [reader entrance](knowledge/overview.md#reader-entrance-and-available-operations) precedes use; the [auxiliary-perimeter check](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#global-hinge-and-chord-comparison) closes the additional input needed by chord conversion. Technical gluing and foundational theorems remain precise imports, while [wider branches](knowledge/overview.md#wider-branches-and-evidence-status) retain their old limits.

fast_route_reconstruction: Recovered S -> tr S -> j/s_k^{n-1} -> zero-truncated angular q -> weighted ball ratio from the [six-step Ricci route](knowledge/overview.md#ricci-lower-bounds-to-ball-volume), including why matrix comparison is not needed for trace and why Myers enters only at positive-k saturation. Recovered the [sectional route](knowledge/overview.md#sectional-bounds-to-jacobi-length-and-hessian) from operator order to Hessian and logarithmic Jacobi length, and obtained the usable k=0 conclusions Delta r <= (n-1)/r and volume doubling 2^n. This is the author's actual reconstruction with prior knowledge, not a measured novice outcome.

fast_route_reconstruction: From the [Myers route](knowledge/overview.md#myers-from-endpoint-fields-to-global-finiteness), obtained a negative endpoint-zero index sum followed by compactness and a finite universal-cover fiber. From the [Hadamard route](knowledge/overview.md#hadamard-from-local-invertibility-to-a-global-cover), separated local nonsingularity, completeness of the pullback metric, covering and one sheet. From the [Toponogov route](knowledge/overview.md#toponogov-from-local-lengths-to-global-triangles), recovered the distinction between SSS and SAS data and the need for local chord containment, moving-center uniformity and a separate global shrinking argument.

slow_step_reproduction: Recomputed dPhi(w)=Aw, the Gram matrix diag(1,A^T A), and positive j=det A before conjugacy at the [density construction](knowledge/nodes/N-D-jacobi.md#from-the-radial-differential-to-volume-density). Recomputed the [scalar pole calculation](knowledge/nodes/N-M-trace.md#singular-scalar-comparison-by-an-integrating-factor): u=O(t), mu~Ct^2, so the initial product vanishes. Recomputed the [weighted quotient](knowledge/nodes/N-M-cut-integration.md#a-positive-weighted-average): F>=q, local absolute continuity and F'=(w/W)(q-F)<=0. The geometric numerator/denominator and small-radius limit were checked, not assumed.

slow_step_reproduction: At the [endpoint index calculation](knowledge/nodes/N-D-index.md#an-endpoint-field-calculation), integration by parts gives I(J,W)=0 for endpoint-zero W; the trial field fE gives integral [ff'] and c_k(L)|X|^2. The [Myers sine calculation](knowledge/nodes/N-M-myers.md#the-sine-field-calculation) gives (n-1)L((pi/L)^2-k)/2<0. The [full exponential differential](knowledge/nodes/N-M-hadamard.md#the-radial-and-angular-parts-of-the-differential) gives squared norm a^2+|J_w|^2/t^2, and the [inverse branches](knowledge/nodes/N-M-hadamard.md#why-the-local-isometry-is-a-covering) are disjoint and exhaustive by reversed radial lifts.

slow_step_reproduction: For the [model chord](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#from-angular-and-radial-speeds-to-length), min(a+s,b+L-s)<R keeps the entire curve in the domain before integrating the speed inequality. For the [shrinking hinges](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#shrinking-hinges-and-the-cauchy-limit), the 9/5 consecutive-displacement estimate sums to 9P_0(4/5)^n, making vertices Cauchy; endpoints follow because their distance to the vertex is at most P_n. The [uniform nearby-center radius](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#a-uniform-local-neighborhood-for-moving-centers) supplies the final contradiction. The [chord-conversion perimeter sum](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#global-hinge-and-chord-comparison) is exactly bounded by the original P.

condition_transfer: Sectional-to-Ricci replacement loses the radial operator bound first; the [product example](knowledge/nodes/N-E-product.md#explanation-and-evidence) gives an actual mixed-direction Hessian and hinge failure. Ricci-upper reversal fails at the uncontrolled -Q term in the [trace equation](knowledge/nodes/N-M-trace.md#what-the-hypotheses-do-not-give). Omitting cut truncation loses bijective ball counting; reversing a raywise bound loses it at the downward jump; setting s_k=0 loses division, repaired by the [terminal sphere and saturation](knowledge/nodes/N-M-cut-integration.md#the-positive-curvature-endpoint). These are differentiated from broader unproved assertions.

condition_transfer: Removing completeness can prevent exp from being defined on all tangent vectors, while removing simple connectivity leaves the flat cylinder's many-sheet covering; see [Hadamard's final steps](knowledge/nodes/N-M-hadamard.md#one-sheet-and-unique-minimizing-geodesics). Letting the model comparison curve leave its normal domain, dropping uniformity in the moving vertex, using nonminimizing sides, or reaching perimeter 2D_k invalidates a stated input in the [triangle boundary analysis](knowledge/nodes/N-M-toponogov.md#first-failures-when-conditions-are-changed). The [flat torus calculation](knowledge/nodes/N-E-global-reverse.md#explanation-and-evidence) separately disproves unrestricted reverse global hinge comparison.
